properties.name: Reasoning crosses designs within a hub; the no-export line names .reflow2.toml; delete_node takes the id prefix as the stated type
properties.rationale: Anthony's word 2026-10-19, "Merge 775. Then start phase 4b". Item 1 is req:reasoning-crosses-designs-within-a-hub (B of the 10-18 build list), from case 3 of the 10-18 proof of concept (fact:reasoning-embedded-in-a-traditional-design-works-within-one-design-and-stops-at-premises-with-no-truth-and-at-design-borders-2026-10-18). WHERE EACH PART LIVES: the core holds one design and opens no other, so it gets the semantics (reflow2_core::far: what a reference reads as, given a reading) and the server that holds every design gets the assembly (service::far, at the registry and the hub view P4a extended), so a local --registry-root hub behind a gateway gets it as flo2.io does; flo2 sends nothing new for it. The readings are per call, never stored on the shared design handle, because two callers may read different designs: a thread-local scope the server installs on every poll of the call's future, recorded with its reason in no_per_design_process_globals. One design's guard at a time throughout, as in the view. What "stale" means is a judgement, built as live truth with stale = the far node gone, and put to the owner as dec:idea-a-far-premise-reads-its-live-truth-and-stale-means-the-far-node-is-gone (proposed). MEASURED BEFORE on flo2.io 0.88.0: calc's inf:the-fermat-theorem-proved-elsewhere-makes-a-failure-a-proof-of-compositeness read its premise "reflow2 computes no truth for a Resource", its claim unproven; propagate_from on ef749c7f6e03a853:req:fermats-little-theorem gave boundary_crossings []. The same shapes on the branch's registry test: the claim reads shown and the walk enters the citing design. Item 2 is req:the-no-export-line-names-every-source-a-writing-call-reads, root cause fact:root-cause-the-no-export-hint-was-written-before-reflow2-toml-became-a-source-and-nothing-holds-it-to-the-resolver-2026-10-19; option (a) of dec:idea-the-no-export-line-names-every-source-the-resolver-reads-reflow2-toml-first. Item 3 is req:delete-node-takes-the-id-prefix-as-the-callers-stated-type, root cause fact:root-cause-delete-node-requires-its-type-by-ruling-and-its-refusal-never-says-so-2026-10-19; option (b) of dec:idea-delete-node-says-why-it-asks-for-the-type-or-takes-the-id-prefix-as-the-callers-word. THIS REOPENS RULING #3b (2026-09-06, chg:a-node-is-named-by-its-id-and-the-type-is-optional-across-the-relation-surface) FOR delete_node ONLY, on Anthony's word: delete_node_still_requires_the_type_on_purpose became delete_node_refuses_an_id_whose_prefix_names_another_type_and_the_node_survives. The typed-id convention had no single table (the prefixes were stated in each constructor's id description and partly in ingest.rs); nodes::node::ID_PREFIXES is now that table, held to the served descriptions by a test. Toolsnap: delete_node's node_type required -> optional (additive). Tests first, each watched failing on main 62e9c84f3: 3 of 3 registry tests (item 1), the line-order test (item 2), 5 of 5 delete tests (item 3). Adopted with this PR (--adopt): the coordinating session's live writes of 10-19 — the two requirements for items 2 and 3, the three decisions (two settled, describe_schema's brief form deferred) and their AUTHORED_BY / EVOLVES_INTO edges. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: P4b. (1) A premise that is a reference to a node in another design (xref:<design>:<node>) now reads as that node reads there: on a registry behind a trusted host the far node is read in its own design before each call (under its guard alone, only if the caller may read it) and handed to the call; its proof status there limits a proof here, and what it holds only under makes the claim here conditional. A far node that is gone reads stale and a far design the caller may not read reads unreachable, both unknown. Through a hub's address, propagate_from and propagate_change continue into each design of the view that holds a reference to a node the walk reached (across_designs; the references named in boundary_crossings). (2) The line a writing --call prints when it keeps no export is generated from call_export::SOURCES, the list find() reads, naming <project>/.reflow2.toml [export] path first. (3) delete_node's node_type is optional: omitted, the id's prefix (nodes::node::ID_PREFIXES) is the caller's stated type, and anything but one holder of that type is refused, deleting nothing.
